name: Establishment of Tea Factories - Uttarakhand Tea Development Board
benefit:
In the fiscal year 2023-24, the Uttarakhand Tea Development Board processed 5.92 lakh kilograms of green tea leaves and produced approximately 1.25 lakh cups of tea.
At present, the Board has established its own tea factories in the following districts:

   1. Tea Factory, Ghorakhal (Nainital) – Organic
   1. Tea Factory, Champawat – Organic
   1. Tea Factory, Bhatoli (Chamoli) – Organic
   1. Tea
_eligibility_text: It is proposed to operate the above tea factories established by the Board in Public-Private Partnership (PPP) mode/private sector in the future, for which the eligibility criteria and policy are being prepared.
